jobs.name: אייקון-01-משקולת-והתקדמות
jobs.title: משקולת והתקדמות
jobs.description: זיהוי ברור של עולם הכושר, עם דגש על מעקב והתקדמות.
jobs.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Produce ONE original finished application icon concept for a personal fitness coaching app, used by coaches and trainees for workouts and progress. Square 1:1 canvas. The entire square canvas is the app icon artwork with full-bleed colored background; do not show the icon on a phone, presentation board or separate mockup. One centered bold recognizable symbol with generous safe margins, visually readable at 48px. Cohesive premium soft-purple visual language. No text, letters, numerals, badges, existing brand logos, borders or watermark. No tiny details. Concept: a bold ivory-white horizontal dumbbell with simple rounded weight plates, centered within a thick almost-complete lavender circular progress ring. Ring has one clearly open gap at upper right, no arrowhead and no numbers. Solid vivid purple background #6A45F5, accent ring #C4B5FD. Flat clean geometric design, crisp edges, symmetric dumbbell and optically centered ring. Ring and dumbbell do not touch. Avoid rendering a photo or a detailed gym scene.

jobs.title: מאמן ומתאמן

jobs.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Produce ONE original finished application icon concept for a personal fitness coaching app, used by coaches and trainees for workouts and progress.
